sources.excerpt: Pigtronix XL FAT Drive User Manual | 3 pages Manuals Directory ManualsDir.com - online owner manuals library Search Directory Brands Pigtronix manuals Audio accessories XL FAT Drive Manual Pigtronix XL FAT Drive User Manual Xl fat drive - users guide Text mode Original mode Advertising XL FAT Drive - Users Guide Welcome to the realm of Pigtronix! Your new XL FAT Drive is an all analog distortion and boost pedal designed to impart warm, tube sound overdrive along with a powerful clean boost, while remaining transparent and true to your original guitar tone. The XL FAT Drive is sensitive to your playing dynamics and will respond musically no matter how soft or hard you push it. Both sections of this pedal are true bypass, allowing you to use either circuit independently or combine both for a massive tone. FAT Drive Section The VOLUME control sets the overall output level. The GAIN control determines how much distortion the XL FAT Drive adds to your sound when engaged. The “MORE” switch significantly increases the pedal’s gain when put in the up (more) position. The TONE knob controls a passive low pass filter. When the TONE knob is fully clockwise, the filter is taken completely out of the circuit, for maximum brightness.
